sources.snippet: Overview Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct is a multilingual instruction-tuned language model developed by meta-llama with 8 billion parameters, released July 23, 2024. The model uses an optimized transformer architecture with grouped-query attention (GQA) for efficient inference, trained on approximately 15 trillion tokens of publicly available data with a knowledge cutoff of December 2023. sources.title: Fine-tuning Llama3 Models with LoRA on Custom Data
sources.snippet: Meta just released Llama3.1 models yesterday (23rd of July, 2024), so I thought it would be a great time to discuss how we can fine-tune Llama 3 models. In this blog, we will fine-tune the Llama3 8B model with Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), to enhance its performance on particular tasks/datasets.
